label: Bibliography
heading: Research, knowledge and dialogue.
lead: Explore my publications, articles, conference contributions and invited lectures — connecting scientific research with environmental policy, sustainable development and practice.

categories.name: Publications
categories.description: Books, book chapters, monographs, manuals and reports presenting research findings, practical methodologies and approaches to environmental management.

categories.name: Articles
categories.description: Scientific and professional articles covering aquatic ecology, biodiversity conservation, water management, stakeholder participation and sustainability.

categories.name: Conferences
categories.description: Contributions to national and international conferences, including oral presentations, posters and published abstracts — sharing findings and exchanging perspectives across disciplines.

categories.name: Invited lectures
categories.description: Invited lectures and presentations for universities, institutions and professional audiences, bringing research and practical experience into discussions on environmental challenges and sustainable development.
